title: Weekly check-in on organic search and the site
description: One typed question in a fresh chat: how organic search and the site did last week and what to change. The fixture is the Magister Marketing project (magistermarketing.com) with its own Google Analytics and Search Console properties cloned onto the lane by make lane-clone and their daily pulls in Library › Analytics and under data/<source>/ on the machine; on an ArtWorks fixture the agent rightly refused to report another brand's properties (hbench smoke, 2026-10-21). The outcome is read from the machine transcript, never from the reply: every number the agent states must appear in the analytics results it actually read (rounded, or a percentage of two of them), and its recommendation must name a page or query present in those rows. The responder answers a question with 'Yes, go ahead.' at most twice; the run ends at the end of the turn after the last reply, or at 15 minutes.
